referenceData.instructions: Authored fictional AI reporting experiments with separate fixed reference cases, scored execution records and operating measurements.
Prefilled values are fictional examples. Changing part of the workbook can leave example inputs in the case.
Edit the named input sheets. Keep worksheet names, column headers and record identifiers. Do not add formulas. Other case inputs remain unchanged.

Report times are minutes after midnight (09:00 = 540). Experiment planning uses elapsed days. Workload and available capacity are hours per week. Money is integer USD cents. All bundled observations are fictional; replace scored records, not the frozen factor or outcome rules.
Upload this workbook, inspect the changes and diagnostics, then apply. Importing does not calculate results or establish operating permission.
